wifi.title: WiFi Network Registration
wifi.description: Register your venue's WiFi IP address so guests on the same network can order without entering a PIN.
wifi.statusMatches: Current IP matches the registered one
wifi.statusMismatch: Current IP does not match the registered one (you're on a different network)

pin.title: Order PIN Code
pin.description: Guests who are not on your WiFi enter this 4-digit code to verify their order. The code stays valid until you generate a new one — it does not rotate daily.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1: Once your venue's WiFi IP is registered, guests ordering from that network are verified automatically.
howItWorks.step2: Guests who aren't on your WiFi (on mobile data, for example) enter the PIN code.
howItWorks.step3: Even on your WiFi, a guest can verify with the PIN if they prefer.

qrOrdering.title: QR Ordering
qrOrdering.description: Guests can scan the QR code and order straight from the table. Turn it off and the menu becomes a showcase: prices and items stay visible, ordering buttons disappear, and a waiter takes the order instead.
qrOrdering.statusOnHint: Guests can order from their table.
qrOrdering.statusOffHint: Menu is in showcase mode. Ordering buttons are hidden.
